_comment: Site configuration: the identifier formats of YOUR sequencing core.
Copy to site.json (gitignored) and edit. Scripts prefer site.json when present.
request_id.regex: matches a request ID in a path or CSV cell; group 1 is the number.
request_id.format: rebuilds the canonical ID from that number.
request_id.csv_column: the metadata.csv column holding the request ID.
project_code_regex: group 1 is an internal project code inside 'Scientific Projects'.
legacy_anchor_keys: optional. Older anchor key names to keep reading in an existing store.
backend: 'globus' (default; also when absent) or 'local'. /setup writes it. Only 'local' enables scan_local.py and LOCAL.md.
local_roots: local backend only. Directories forage may read; every scan path must lie inside one.
local_label: local backend only, optional. collection_id recorded for local scans (default local:<hostname>). Keep it stable.
